description: This header file declares the interface for a keyword set library, including data structures, function prototypes for keyword set allocation, construction, search, and deallocation, sourced from GNU grep, with some modifications.

methods.name: kwsalloc
methods.description: Allocates a new keyword set with optional character translation table.

methods.name: kwsincr
methods.description: Incrementally adds a keyword to the set.

methods.name: kwsprep
methods.description: Prepares the keyword set for use after all keywords have been added.

methods.name: kwsexec
methods.description: Searches for matches of the keyword set within a buffer.

methods.name: kwsfree
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with a keyword set.

ctags.name: index
ctags.pattern: /^  int index;			\/* Index number of matching keyword. *\/$/

ctags.name: offset
ctags.pattern: /^  size_t offset[1];		\/* Offset of each submatch. *\/$/

ctags.name: size
ctags.pattern: /^  size_t size[1];		\/* Length of each submatch. *\/$/
